Another time, he turned and smiled at me in his rearview. It’s not just coincidence. I’m sure he’s trying to tell me how he feels without speaking.

I’ve written him letters—just small ones, sweet things—but I haven’t sent them. I don’t want to scare him. Lately, I’ve been sleeping less, but I don’t feel tired. My mind races, and I clean my apartment at 3 a.m., organize old photos, write poems. I’ve even thought about quitting my job—maybe becoming a poet, or traveling. But then I worry: is this real?
